retained_preexisting_limitations: The prior urban fixed-point solver overflows its first 2*HUGE comparison when floating-point overflow trapping is enabled. Complete urban fixtures trap invalid and zero; isolated new column fixtures also trap overflow.

Synthetic category 3, Tin=307 K, dt=6 s, AC fraction=0.6 fails the prior urban fixed-point solver at FGR=0. Reproduced with pre-change source. Targeted roof matrix uses Tin=299 K; thresholds were not relaxed.
